title: Apply for Season 1
description: Applications are open until December 20, 2026. Teams are announced on January 2, kickoff is January 4.

steps.name: Join Discord
steps.text: Get to know the community and introduce yourself in #introductions. Watching one stream before you apply helps.

steps.name: Fill in the form
steps.text: Tell us your role, your experience, how many hours a week you can give and your GitHub profile.

steps.name: Short call
steps.text: A 20-minute intro for mentors; a group intro for participants.

steps.name: Matching
steps.text: On January 2 your team and project are announced and your project channel opens.

formHint: In the message, include: the role you're applying for (Participant, Mentor or Idea owner), your experience in short, hours per week and your GitHub profile.
